verdict.rationale: Klaviyo provides a Postman collection of pre-built API requests and a sandboxed test account for exploring the API, plus reference pages describing individual endpoints, but this relies on an external tool (Postman) rather than an in-browser interactive 'try it out' console with runnable examples. missing for 10: evidence of a native in-docs interactive API explorer/console, runnable code snippets embedded in the reference pages themselves.
